title: LMT LAB DAY Chicago 2027
body_markdown:
Join 3D Systems at LMT LAB DAY Chicago 2027 where we are excited to present on educational topics from 3D Printing Digital Dentures, RPDs, and more. Learn about our industry first technology for multi-material, monolithic dentures with the NextDent Jetted Denture Solution.


Visit us at booth A-43/B-42 to discover more about this solution and other dental innovations.


**LAB DAY Chicago**


Join LMT for the 42nd Annual LAB DAY Chicago, the Largest Dental Laboratory Show in the World!
